comparability: Earth route:6 mathematics courses45 EC,4 programming/data courses30 EC,13 environment/sustainability courses97.5 EC and PPD7.5 EC. The environmental courses have real waves/materials, geoscience, climate and energy content, but do not provide sustained mechanics/electromagnetism/quantum/astronomy or physics laboratory work. Brain route:12 mathematics/programming/data/statistical/research-synthesis courses90 EC,10 brain/biomedical/development courses75 EC, philosophy7.5 EC and PPD7.5 EC. Neurobiology/perception and LTI signal methods are genuine contributions; generic image processing is not physical instrumentation, biological development is not neurophysics and linear time-invariant systems is not nonlinear dynamics/chaos. Both48 original placements pass actual prerequisites/offerings; scheduling feasibility does not establish comparability.

candidateAssessment.label: Mathematics, data & physical Earth systems
candidateAssessment.reason: UCR offers genuine mathematics, programming, data analysis, Earth-system science and neuroscience. The proposed Earth-systems and brain/perception compositions are coherent in those subjects, but do not sustain the cumulative mechanics, electromagnetism, quantum theory, astronomy and experimental-physics training that defines this target. Sustainability waves/materials, geospatial data and biological perception provide limited connections rather than the missing physics sequence. No complete, substantively defensible UCR response is established; this is not a demand for degree equivalence or a quota of matched rows.

candidateAssessment.reason: UCR has image processing, Earth observation and quantitative methods, but no astronomy, stellar or planetary physics, relativity, gravitation or observational-astronomy sequence. These methods cannot sustain a complete astronomy curriculum.

candidateAssessment.label: Fundamental & experimental physics
candidateAssessment.reason: UCR lacks mechanics, electromagnetism, optics, thermodynamics, quantum theory, relativity and an experimental-physics laboratory sequence. Mathematics, modelling and Earth science are related contributions, not replacements for this cumulative core.

candidateAssessment.label: Atomic & molecular physics

candidateAssessment.label: High-energy & particle physics
candidateAssessment.reason: UCR offers no particle physics, gravitational physics, quantum field theory or preceding mechanics and electromagnetism sequence.

candidateAssessment.label: Solid-state & condensed-matter physics
candidateAssessment.reason: Environmental materials courses do not provide electronic structure, crystallography, quantum mechanics, solid-state physics or experimental condensed-matter work.

candidateAssessment.reason: UCR lacks the undergraduate physics content and physics didactics needed for a coherent teaching-physics route; the limitation is academic preparation, not qualification alone.
